messages.subject: [Scheduled] DMS and Outlook maintenance - Saturday 17 May, 06:00-10:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Please note that the document management system (FileSite) and Outlook web access will be unavailable this Saturday 17 May between 06:00 and 10:00 BST for scheduled patching. Desktop Outlook will continue to work in cached mode. No action is required. Please save and close any open documents before Friday evening.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
ext. 4000
